alerts.title: Average basket is 5.3% down on the quarter
alerts.body: The last 13 weeks averaged $176 against $186 in the 13 before. The gap is larger than normal week-to-week variation would produce.

alerts.title: New customers is 10.0% up on the quarter
alerts.body: The last 13 weeks averaged 708 against 644 in the 13 before. The gap is larger than normal week-to-week variation would produce.

alerts.title: SK is behaving unusually for the time of year
alerts.body: SK revenue is 2.9 standard deviations above its own seasonal baseline (two of three weeks beyond two standard deviations). It is 1.7% of province revenue.

alerts.title: Service contacts is below its seasonal baseline
alerts.body: Service contacts is 8 weeks in a row on one side of the baseline. The latest week is 755 against an expected 930. This is a pattern, not a single odd week.

alerts.title: $5,159,840 of margin sits with customers likely to lapse
alerts.body: The churn model expects 17,611 active customers to stop buying within six months. Nearly half that value sits with the top tenth, so the list is workable.

alerts.title: Active customers is 4.2% up on the quarter
alerts.body: The last 13 weeks averaged 15,607 against 14,974 in the 13 before. The gap is larger than normal week-to-week variation would produce.

alerts.title: $523,123 a year available from the same media budget
alerts.body: The mix model, calibrated on in-market tests, puts more weight on flyer and email and less on display. The gain is real but modest, and depends on the tests being repeated.

alerts.title: Realised price is above its seasonal baseline
alerts.body: Realised price is 8 weeks in a row on one side of the baseline. The latest week is 97.3% against an expected 96.7%. This is a pattern, not a single odd week.

alerts.title: Outdoor & Garden is down 45% and that is normal
alerts.body: Outdoor & Garden revenue has fallen 45% against the previous quarter, which looks alarming on a standard report. Against its own seasonal pattern it is 0.1 standard deviations from where it should be, which is to say exactly where it should be. No action needed.
